Triage: **`finding`** (observation-class — register/appearance inconsistency, no functional impact; held for the findings round, not queued today).

- **Premise verified on `origin/main` (aca561a)**: `packages/i18n/src/locales/es.ts` — `preview.draftBar.message` uses tú (`estás`, `publiques`) at :3236 while `messageClean` (:3232, `ve`) and `sampleDataBody` (:3234, `Está`, `su`, `Publíquela`) use usted. All three values live as described; the em-dash/colon divergence also confirmed.
- **Classification basis**: real and user-visible (a Spanish user sees the banner switch register after publishing), but it is a wording-register polish item — the "外观瑕疵" class the finding state exists for. The fix direction is already well-argued in the body (A: align `message` to usted, matching the es package default and slice-5's 19 new `preview.*` keys); nothing blocks a later promotion, likely packaged with the #3810/#3582/#3625 value-domain-blind-spot family as a sweep card. Option C (a register gate) is correctly argued against by the card itself — morphological detection is unreliable and neighborhood boundaries are human judgment (#3546 slice-2 precedent).
- **Routing**: in-repo objectui card — pm-state only, no `domain:*` (whole-repo seat).
- **Dedup**: repo-scoped search (`usted draftBar`, MCP) returns only this card; no open PR touches these two keys (#3546 slice 5 deliberately excluded them, per body). Not a duplicate of #3810 (dead defaultValues) or #3625 — new sub-class: intra-locale register split on one component.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

- **Grade basis**: user-visible register switch on a single banner within one session — polish, but cheap, fully specified, and direction already argued: **direction A** (align `message` to usted + restore the em-dash), matching the es package default (102:30 usted census) and slice-5's 19 new `preview.*` keys. Option C (register gate) stays not-recommended per the card's own analysis.
- **Batching note for the lane**: sweep-batchable with the already-queued #3810/#3845 value-domain family (same blind-spot class, disjoint keys) — one sweep card / one PR / itemized checklist is the natural shape if the lane takes all three together.
